faqs.question: What exactly does Score AI do?
faqs.answer: Score AI analyzes your content with 30+ micro criteria, gives a 0-100 score, and provides actionable suggestions to improve performance. It learns your brand, derives insights from past data, and speeds up your content workflow.

faqs.question: Is my content secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your content is stored securely and is not shared with third parties.

faqs.question: Is Score AI free?
faqs.answer: You can try the Starter plan free for 7 days, no credit card required. Upgrade to Pro when you need regular analysis.

faqs.question: Can I change my plan later?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or change your plan anytime as your analysis volume grows.

systems.resourceDescription: A one-page method for turning channel numbers into a decision you can act on this week.

systems.name: Flowin
systems.tagline: Helps teams turn LinkedIn outreach into a scalable growth engine by automating profile visits, connection requests, personalized messages, and follow-ups while tracking every lead interaction in one place.
systems.description: Helps teams turn LinkedIn outreach into a scalable growth engine by automating profile visits, connection requests, personalized messages, and follow-ups while tracking every lead interaction in one place.
systems.heroSubtitle: Flowin helps teams turn LinkedIn outreach into a scalable growth engine by automating profile visits, connection requests, personalized messages, and follow-ups while tracking every lead interaction in one place.

features.title: Smart Outreach Flow Builder
features.body: A visual automation flow that lets teams design LinkedIn outreach sequences with profile visits, connection requests, wait steps, conditional replies, InMail actions, and follow-up messages based on lead behavior.

features.title: Growth & Campaign Intelligence
features.body: A performance dashboard that shows campaign activity, sent messages, new connections, response rates, key alerts, and trend insights so teams can quickly understand what drives pipeline growth.

faqs.question: Is Flowin safe to use with LinkedIn?
faqs.answer: Yes. Flowin is built for measured outreach, with pacing and controls that keep activity inside a professional range instead of spraying the network.

faqs.question: How long does it take to see results?
faqs.answer: Most teams see a cleaner pipeline within the first two weeks once one live flow is running. The first useful signal is usually reply quality, not volume.

faqs.question: Can I use my own LinkedIn account?
faqs.answer: Yes. Flowin works with the account your team already uses, so outreach stays in your name and your relationships.

faqs.question: Do you provide onboarding?
faqs.answer: Yes. We help you map the first journey, connect the account and launch one campaign you can actually measure.

faqs.question: Can I pause or stop campaigns anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every campaign can be paused or stopped immediately. Nothing continues in the background without you.

systems.resourceDescription: Learn how B2B teams build a repeatable LinkedIn outreach system, with practical examples and campaign templates you can adapt.

systems.name: Nera Social
systems.tagline: Manages social media, content, and campaigns through an integrated marketing system.
systems.description: The growth agency behind Nera. Strategy, creative and media execution that turns visibility into a sales opportunity.
systems.heroTitle: A growth agency built around systems.
systems.heroSubtitle: Nera Social plans, creates and runs the work that feeds every system in the Nera stack, from social and ads to CRM and sales tracking.

features.title: Strategy that starts with the sale
features.body: We do not treat social, ads and content as isolated channels. Every brief is designed to move a person from first impression to a measurable sales opportunity.

features.title: Execution that compounds
features.body: Creative, media and community work run as one system, so the brand stays consistent while performance keeps improving week after week.

faqs.question: Is Nera Social an application or an agency?
faqs.answer: Nera Social is our growth agency. It is the team and the practice that feeds our product systems with strategy, creative and paid media.

faqs.question: Can we work with Nera Social without using the other systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many brands start with the agency. The systems become useful when you want the same work to be measurable, repeatable and easier to scale.

systems.resourceTitle: How Nera connects marketing to sales
systems.resourceDescription: A short briefing on how we join social, ads, web, CRM and sales tracking into one growth structure.

faqs.question: Can the report change by brand?

features.title: Variations without starting over

features.title: Guardrails, not guesswork

faqs.question: Does Luma replace a design team?

systems.name: Nera Pop Up
systems.description: Timed, targeted site prompts that collect the right lead at the right moment.
systems.heroTitle: Catch intent while it is still there.
systems.heroSubtitle: Nera Pop Up turns high-intent visits into captured conversations, without covering the whole page in noise.

features.title: The right prompt, not every prompt
features.body: Triggers follow behavior: time on page, exit intent, campaign source. Visitors see a reason to leave their details, not a wall.

features.title: Built to hand off
features.body: Every capture can move into Flowin, a CRM or a simple inbox so the moment does not die in a spreadsheet.

faqs.question: Will this hurt the site experience?
faqs.answer: Only if it is used badly. Nera Pop Up is designed for restraint: one clear offer, one clear next step.

systems.description: Lead intake built for growth teams that need signal, not another unsorted inbox.
systems.heroTitle: Leads with context, not just a name.
systems.heroSubtitle: Nera Leads captures demand and the details that tell you whether it is worth a conversation.

features.title: Intake that asks better questions
features.body: Collect the fields that change routing, need, timing, channel, instead of a generic name-and-email dump.

features.title: Qualification without a meeting
features.body: Simple rules surface who should hear from sales first, so the team does not treat every row as equal.

faqs.question: Can Nera Leads sit on our existing site?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is built to be embedded or linked from campaigns, landing pages and the Nera stack.

features.title: Now, not next week
features.body: When a campaign lands, waiting for a Monday report is too late. Real Time keeps a simple pulse on the activity that matters.

features.title: Alerts with a reason
features.body: Unusual spikes or drops can notify the people who can actually do something about them.

faqs.question: Is this a full analytics suite?
faqs.answer: No. It is a live layer. Score and Repora remain the places for deeper reading and reporting.

systems.heroSubtitle: Nera Forms gives teams a consistent, branded way to collect the information every system downstream depends on.

features.title: Brand-first intake

features.title: Ready for the next system

faqs.question: Can we use Nera Forms for Growth Review?
faqs.answer: The public Growth Review on this site is a dedicated flow. Nera Forms is for the custom intake you need on campaigns and products.
